name: gr1_clip_interrogator_2_generate_image_prompt
description: Generate a Stable Diffusion 2.0 prompt description from an input image. Use this tool when you need to interrogate an image with CLIP Interrogator 2.1 and produce a text prompt. If a user passes a file as an input, use the upload_file_to_gradio tool, if present, to upload the file to the gradio app and create a Gradio File Input. Then use the returned path as the input to the tool. Returns: str: Generated prompt description, or an upload prompt when no image is provided. (from fffiloni/CLIP-Interrogator-2)

interrogation_mode.description: Interrogation mode to use: best, classic, or fast.

best_mode_max_flavors.description: Maximum number of flavors used only when interrogation_mode is best.
